description: Final Fantasy X-2 (PS2 NTSC-U, via PCSX2)
long: Final Fantasy X-2 is the direct sequel to Final Fantasy X, following Yuna, Rikku and Paine as the Gullwings sphere-hunting crew two years after the defeat of Sin. It replaces its predecessor's Sphere Grid with the Dressphere and Garment Grid system, letting the three party members switch jobs mid-battle in a fully real-time Active Time Battle system. Spira is now freely revisitable via airship, and the story branches through optional missions toward multiple endings.
